post.summary: Authenticate with a direct wallet signature.
post.description:
The server reconstructs the message in this format:
```text
Longshot Wallet Authentication

Version: 1
Domain: <configured_domain>
Auth Address: <checksum_address>
Timestamp: <signed_at_ms>
```
Clients submit the address, timestamp, and signature, not message text.
Wallet authorization defaults to a 60-second freshness window and tolerates
timestamps up to 30 seconds ahead for clock skew. A successful public wallet
session lasts 24 hours; the signing window does not shorten the bearer lifetime.

get.summary: Public read of the engine's per-category profit caps.
get.description:
Caps bound taker profit (and therefore maker liability): payout net of the
taker's returned stake.
MMs poll this so they can clamp `max_fill` ahead of the engine's
`ProfitExceedsMaximum` rejection. Returns the neutral profit-cap config
consumed by external market makers.

The requested `limit` is clamped to 1-50 (default 8). Resolved markets are

ProfitCapConfigResponse.description:
Response for `GET /v1/mm/profit_caps`.

Each cap bounds taker profit (and therefore maker liability) per RFQ — the
payout net of the taker's returned stake — in the protocol's base
micro-unit.

PublicMarket.description: Rich public market detail selected by its strict specification shape.

PublicReferralDepositMatchOffer.description:
Deposit-match offer configured for a referral link. The opportunity is
granted only by atomic Privy signup with a linked X account; direct wallet
signup and later referral attribution intentionally do not qualify.

duration_ms.description: Validity window of the granted opportunity in milliseconds.

match_limit_micros.description: Maximum matched amount in USD micros, as a decimal string.

PublicReferralInviterResponse.description: Public identity of the inviter behind a referral link.

PublicReferralStatusResponse.description: Public status of a referral link.

QueuedWithdrawalResponse.description: First-attempt response for a withdrawal accepted into the onchain queue.

amount_micros.description: Amount committed to the onchain withdrawal queue, in USDC micros.

destination_address.description: EVM address that will receive the queued USDC.

operation_id.description: Operation ID used for idempotency and recovery correlation.

RecentResolutionEntry.description:
Single recent price-market resolution row.

`outcome` is serialized as the wire string (`"YES"` or `"NO"`).
`window_start_ms` identifies the price window and is the canonical field
for ordering resolutions and checking that consecutive windows are
adjacent. `resolved_at_ms` records when settlement completed.

RecentResolutionsResponse.description:
Response for `GET /v1/mm/recent_resolutions`.

Contains recent resolutions for a specific `(asset, duration_secs)` price
market.

ReservedBalanceResponse.description: Response containing the user's currently reserved balance.

reserved_micros.description: Currently reserved user balance in USDC micros.

RfqEstimateRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /v1/rfq/estimate`: a prospective order to price
without reserving or executing anything.

Estimates have no `min_odds`, `order_type`, or idempotency key because they
do not execute an order.

shield_on.description: If true, do not personalize the estimate to the taker's identity.

wager_micros.description:
Wager in micros (e.g., 100000000 = $100.00). Quotes are size-aware, so
this should be the real prospective wager.

RfqEstimateResponse.description:
Current odds estimate for a prospective RFQ. The estimate reflects the odds
the caller would receive by submitting the same order now; nothing is
reserved or executed.

fillable_micros.description: Wager amount (micros) the collected quotes could fill.

odds.description:
Estimated decimal odds multiplier (e.g. 2.5 = 2.5x). Present whenever
at least one quote was collected, even if the wager is only partially
fillable.

quotable.description: True when the collected quotes fully cover the requested wager.

quotes_received.description: Number of maker quotes collected for this estimate.

reason.description:
Why the order is not (fully) quotable: `no_quotes`,
`insufficient_liquidity`, `profit_exceeds_maximum`, `no_valid_quotes`,
`estimate_timeout`, or `sports_combination_unsupported`.

odds.description:
Effective odds (if filled), e.g., 2.5 for 2.5x.
Non-finite values are omitted at serialization boundaries.

account_created.description:
True only when this request's provisioning transaction created the
user account; false for sessions resolved onto an existing account.

address.description: Address associated with the authenticated session. Custodial Privy sessions retain the Longshot-controlled deposit wallet here for compatibility; use `auth_wallet_address` for the authentication wallet.

auth_wallet_address.description:
EVM wallet that authenticated or controls this API account. For Privy
sessions this is the preferred linked EVM wallet; it remains distinct
from the Longshot-controlled custodial deposit wallet.

deposit_address.description: Longshot-controlled deposit wallet address for this user.

deposit_chain_id.description: EVM chain ID for the deposit wallet, when custodial deposits are enabled.

session_token.description: Bearer token for authenticated API requests.

user_id.description: Stable Longshot user ID, encoded as a UUID string.

SignedOrderJson.description:
Signed order in JSON format.

**Signature Computation**: The signature is computed over a binary representation
of the order plus the top-level `CreateRfqRequest::use_app_tokens` funding
choice, NOT the JSON. See [`SignedOrder::signing_bytes`] for the exact format
and [`crate::taker::sign_order`] for the protocol helper.
Key conversions for signing:
- `wager_micros` is encoded directly as micros
- `min_odds` → `min_odds_bps` (multiply by 10,000 and round)

expires_at_ms.description: Submission deadline in Unix milliseconds for this signed payload.

shield_on.description: If true, suppress user tier and EVM address in MM-facing RFQs.

user.description: User's wallet address (hex, with or without 0x prefix).
